description:
Order one human to rewrite a text by hand, without AI. It is paid from your wallet at once when the balance covers it.
Use for: ordering a hand-written rewrite of private text. When your wallet does not cover `cost.total`, the order waits as awaiting_payment and fund_bounty pays it later. The same idempotencyKey returns the first order, ignores new input, and never orders or charges twice.
Not for: paying for an order awaiting payment (fund_bounty); reading where an order stands (get_bounty).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: create_humanization({"sourceText":"Our quarterly results exceeded expectations across every region, driven by strong demand.","transformation":"general_rewrite","subject":"quarterly update","turnaroundMinutes":120,"price":{"amount":2500,"currency":"usd"},"idempotencyKey":"5f0c7a2e-8d4b-4e1a-9c3f-2b6d1e8a7f40"})
Key: the idempotencyKey in the example is a sample. Replace it with a new unique key for each new call, and keep that key for the call’s retries and any confirmation it asks for.
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: humanization_unavailable, listing_refused, pay_below_minimum, duplicate_listing, spending_limit_reached, account_restricted, account_setup_required, wallet_short, create_in_progress; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

applicantScreening.description: Applicants first rewrite a sample of this AI-written text by hand, with a screen recording. The sample is public on the listing.

instructions.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long

percentage.description: Sample size as a share of sourceText. Default 5.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

price.description: What the writer is paid, from $1 to $1,000,000. Our fee is added on top.

requireResume.description: true asks each applicant for a resume. Default false.

sourceText.description: Private text for the accepted writer; 10,000 characters maximum including instructions and the two added newlines when instructions is supplied.

subject.description: A short PUBLIC topic shown in the listing title, such as "essay on AI infrastructure". Never private content.

turnaroundMinutes.description: Estimated writing time, not a deadline from ordering.

name: create_humanization

charge.description: What the first call with this idempotencyKey took from your wallet. Left out when it took nothing, and on a repeat 24 hours or more later: see list_wallet_transactions.

status.description: awaiting_payment: your wallet did not cover it; see payUrl. under_review: the platform checks it first. open: paid, waiting for a writer.

payUrl.description: Set when the first call with this key left the order awaiting_payment: a page where the shortfall can be paid. It can be left out then too; fund_bounty pays for it from your wallet.

title: Order a human rewrite
